# voipms_forwardings (Data Source)

Lists call forwardings (`getForwardings`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_forwardings" "all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `forwardings` (Attributes List) Forwarding destinations on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwardings))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`forwardings`).

<a id="nestedatt--forwardings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forwardings`

Read-Only:

- `callerid_override` (String) Caller ID override.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `diversion_header` (Boolean) SIP Diversion header enabled.
- `dtmf_digits` (String) DTMF digits sent after answer.
- `id` (String) Forwarding id.
- `pause` (String) Pause before DTMF.
- `phone_number` (String) Destination number.
